description: describeScheduleWorkItems batch-resolves (work_item_type, work_item_id) to {label, title, link, ticketId?, done} for ticket, interaction, project_task, opportunity_step, appointment_request and ad_hoc
Descriptor: interaction with ticket_id links to the ticket and carries ticketId; label is the interaction type name
Descriptor: interaction without ticket and ad_hoc entries link to the schedule deep link
Descriptor: project_task links to the task, opportunity_step to the opportunity, appointment_request to /msp/schedule?requestId=
Descriptor done-state: interaction is_closed, ticket closed, project task closed status, appointment request not approved, opportunity step completed; missing work item reported as missing
Schedule page accepts ?entryId= (and optional occurrence) and opens the schedule at that date with the entry open
Search indexer uses the schedule deep link instead of the non-existent /msp/schedule/{entry_id} route
Migration adds internal notification category 'schedule' and subtype 'schedule-entry-reminder' (enabled by default, default priority normal)
Template 'schedule-entry-reminder' with title/body for lead > 0 and lead = 0 variants, in all 9 supported locales
Dev seed includes the new template
Migration adds toast_on_arrival boolean (default false) to internal_notification_subtypes; true for schedule-entry-reminder
Per-user lead preference stored in user_preferences as schedule_reminder_lead_minutes; allowed 0/5/10/15/30/60, normalized sorted unique; default [15] when unset; empty = off
Profile > Notifications shows a Schedule reminders lead-time multi-select next to the category toggle and saves the preference
GET/PUT /api/v1/users/me/schedule-reminder-preferences returns and updates {leadMinutes, enabled, serverDelivered: true}; self-only; validated
OpenAPI, SDK and chat/MCP registries regenerated for the preference endpoint
Migration creates tenant-distributed schedule_entry_reminder_deliveries ledger keyed (tenant, entry_id, occurrence_start, user_id, lead_minutes) with state, attempts, notification_id, timestamps
SCHEDULE_REMINDER_LEDGER registered with the shared delivery claim protocol (claim -> create notification -> finish sent/failed)
schedule-reminder-scan maintenance job defined with defineJob, scope tenant, cron every minute, running on CE (pg-boss) and EE (Temporal fan-out)
Tenant selector fans out only to tenants with a timed entry starting within the scan horizon or an active recurring master
Scan loads timed non-recurring entries in [now-5m, now+70m] with assignees, excluding null start, all-day, and closed/completed/cancelled status
Scan expands active recurring masters over the window with generateOccurrences, honouring exceptions and holidays, keyed by master entry_id + occurrence start
Candidates are (occurrence, assignee, lead) with fire_at = start - lead in [now-10m, now] and occurrence start no more than 5 minutes past; older ones are dropped
Candidates whose work item is done or missing (descriptor) are skipped
Recipients are filtered to active users with a non-empty lead preference and the reminder subtype enabled (tenant and user level)
Assignees are read at scan time, so reassignment before fire_at changes who is reminded
Each candidate is claimed in the ledger before delivery; a claimed key is never delivered again across concurrent scans or retries

Delivery creates the internal notification in the server process via createNotificationFromTemplateInternal with link and metadata {entryId, occurrenceStart, leadMinutes, workItemType, workItemId, ticketId?}
Notification text formats start time in the recipient's effective timezone and locale
Scan purges ledger rows older than 30 days
Fix generateOccurrences if timed recurring series omit their first occurrence (open question 5)
Web: notifications arriving via the live signal whose subtype has toast_on_arrival show a toast with title, body and Open action following the link
Web: the toast never fires for notifications already present at page load or fetched by polling catch-up after reconnect beyond a short freshness window
pushNotificationDispatcher resolves schedule-entry-reminder to a new 'schedule' push target
buildScheduleReminderPushMessage sends data {kind:'schedule-reminder', entryId, workItemType, workItemId, url} with no top-level ticketId/taskId
Push for reminders is sent only to tokens whose app_version meets the configured minimum; getActivePushTokensForUser selects app_version
Mobile: detects server reminder support via the preference endpoint (200 = supported) and caches the result per server
Mobile: Settings > Calendar reminders reads/writes the server preference when supported (adds 'At start time' option), else keeps the local preference
Mobile: when supported, cancels pending local schedule-reminder notifications and stops scheduling new ones
Mobile: logout cancels pending local schedule reminders
Mobile: tapping a server reminder push opens the ticket for ticket/interaction entries, else the schedule (existing reminder routing)
Teams notification categories defined once in a shared constant and imported by every current copy
Teams: new category schedule_reminder classified from template schedule-entry-reminder; off by default per tenant
Teams: activity type scheduleReminderDue declared in the app manifest; TEAMS_PACKAGE_VERSION bumped
Teams: bot DM adaptive card for reminders with title, start time and Open link
Teams settings shows the Schedule reminders category with channel selector and a re-upload hint for the activity feed
Teams deep link maps reminder ticket links to the ticket tab and other reminder links to My Work
